title: Moses and the Magicians of Pharaoh

paragraphs.text: Pharaoh asked Moses to show a sign. Moses threw his staff, and it became a clear serpent. He drew out his hand, and it shone white for all to see. Pharaoh's chiefs said, "This is a skilled magician. He wants to drive you out of your land." They told Pharaoh to wait. He should send men to the cities to gather every skilled magician.

The magicians came to Pharaoh. They asked for a reward if they won. Pharaoh promised a reward and a place close to him. The magicians asked Moses who would throw first. Moses said, "Throw." Their magic tricked the people's eyes and filled them with fear. It was a great show of magic. Then Allah told Moses to throw his staff. At once it swallowed their false tricks. The truth became clear, and their work came to nothing. Pharaoh and his people were defeated and made low.
Then the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Moses and Aaron."
